alias_boundary: PyWhy is an umbrella; causal-learn and EconML are distinct dependencies/integrations, not aliases or family-level permissions.
decision_scope: Defer executable adapter admission; select optional pinned DoWhy identification as the preferred prototype path, and use its explicit model/identify/estimate separation as a proposal reference now.
rationale: Identification is a useful reusable service given a supplied causal graph. Direct adoption of all estimator/refuter/GCM/discovery paths would add unreviewed semantics and dependency scope.
The MIT source grant is inspected. No complete runtime dependency lock/license closure or behavioral execution exists for this revision, so design selection does not grant integration_allowed.
DoWhy learn_graph is deprecated in the pinned source. Route discovery to separately selected packages and pass a reviewed graph. Do not advertise graph learning as the selected service.

The inspected identify_effect function assigns proceed_when_unidentifiable but does not pass it to either identifier. The adapter must validate the returned estimand and assumptions directly; a flag name is not an effective safety oracle. This is a source finding, not an executed failure claim.

obligations: Retain copyright and permission notice in copies/substantial portions.

license.deployment_choice: Separate optional environment/process to isolate version constraints; process separation is not a waiver of distribution obligations.

missing: Resolved distributions/hashes for a chosen Python/platform.

dependency_review.version_note: Do not label the software version 0.0.0; that is a dynamic-version placeholder. Compatibility comments do not override declarations.

maintenance.observed: Repository commit date and source deprecation/dependency changes are recorded.
revisit_on: Public API or estimand semantics change

preconditions: No duplicate IDs, dangling edges or directed cycles.
Treatment/outcome nodes distinct and valid; preserve latent nodes even when no data column exists.
User assumptions are supplied claims, not conclusions inferred from a successful API call.
Do not let missing graph trigger automatic construction.
Reject unresolved CPDAG/PAG input on this path. A future per-graph identification service needs a separate union/ambiguity contract.

fields: formula with named variables and integration measures
rules: Empty adjustment set is a valid randomized-style result; it is not an empty or absent estimand.
No causal directed path can imply zero under a supplied model, but must not be inferred from an exception or missing result.
A symbolic estimand is not a numerical estimate; no standard error is invented.
If an estimator is later admitted, preserve ATE/ATT/ATC and contrast; record the actual uncertainty method and unavailable uncertainty explicitly.
Unsupported or nonidentified responses must not fall back to predictive regression.

conversion_and_failure_contract.transport: Local versioned JSON request/result; explicit node/edge lists, not arbitrary expression evaluation or downloaded code.
conversion_and_failure_contract.identification: Pass only the selected explicit graph, observed-node set, treatment/outcome and method to the pinned identifier. Convert symbolic output into a restricted expression representation with variable identities; preserve the original expression for inspection.
conversion_and_failure_contract.errors: Return structured variant/reason/next permissible action; preserve logs as diagnostics. No scalar NaN/zero success fallback.
conversion_and_failure_contract.custody: No sibling changes or execution and no external data upload in this decision.

behavioral_oracle.expected: Identify via W: sum_w{E(Y|A=1,w)-E(Y|A=0,w)}P(w). Exact example ATE=2; distinct ATT=2.6 and ATC=1.4 if explicitly requested by later estimators.
No observed backdoor adjustment, frontdoor or instrument in this graph; nonidentified for unrestricted effect. Retain latent W.
Identified contrast without adjustment; empty set is valid.

behavioral_oracle.case: model with no directed A-to-Y path
behavioral_oracle.expected: Model-implied zero with its graph rationale; not a failure substitute.
Do not add C to an adjustment set solely because it is observed.

behavioral_oracle.case: cycle, unknown nodes, duplicate IDs or unresolved CPDAG
behavioral_oracle.expected: invalid_request/unsupported_request, no automatic graph repair or orientation.
Named nodes survive reorder; money/rate conversion preserves the same contrast; ATE does not silently become ATT.

costs.porting_tradeoff: A wrapper reuses upstream algorithms but pays environment/conversion costs; a port reduces selected runtime dependencies only by accepting algorithm and regression-maintenance costs. Measure before choosing.

owner_obligations.current_author: Maintain source/claim audit and limit the proposal to the selected route.
owner_obligations.future_adapter_maintainer: Own lockfile, transformations, notices, fixtures, supported versions and migration tests.
owner_obligations.scientific_owner: Approve target, intervention, clock, graph/latent assumptions and interpretation; cannot delegate truth to the library.

revisit_trigger: Complete a pinned environment/dependency-license review and execute the seven oracle families on the selected revision. Record exact package behavior and bounded resource results in the independent integration task before enabling an executable path.
